question:
Will there be more than ten times as many fatalities in Burundi for the 30 days before {resolution_date} compared to one plus the 30-day average of fatalities over the 360 days preceding {forecast_due_date}?

e.g. If the forecast due date is 2024-01-01 and we have the following data:
Date,fatalities
resolution_criterion: Resolves to the value calculated from the ACLED dataset once the data is published.
